name: sesh-stats
description: Track listening statistics for your current Spotify session.
author: Bojan Raic

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions sesh-stats.js && spicetify apply
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions sesh-stats.js && spicetify apply && spicetify enable-devtools
scripts.undeploy: rm -f "$(spicetify path userdata)/Extensions/sesh-stats.js" && spicetify config extensions sesh-stats.js- && spicetify apply
